notes.title: Baptiste is headed for the Horror Game Awards Summer Showcase!
notes.notes:
[b]Baptiste[/b], the cursed doll, is currently on his way to the [b]Horror Game Awards Summer Showcase[/b], which will take place on May 31st at 11AM PDT / 2PM EDT / 7PM BST! He will be there to show you a new and terrifying trailer, so make sure you check it out!

Tune in and watch the stream on the [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/@HorrorGameAwards/streams]YouTube[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/horrorgameawards]Twitch[/url][/b] channels of The Horror Game Awards to learn more about the horrors that await you in Baptiste, and many other world premieres and amazing horror games!

Baptiste will launch a [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/firenut-games/baptiste-haunted-mansion-terror-with-a-cursed-doll-awaits]Kickstarter campaign[/url][/b] very soon, so if you’re intrigued by what you see in the showcase, make sure you click on that [b]Notify Me on Launch[/b] button! That way, you’ll be the first one to know when the campaign goes live, which will be very soon.

You can also check the event’s Steam page [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45104824/sale/HorrorGameAwardsSummerShowcase]here[/url][/b]. We hope you enjoy the showcase, see you on the stream!

notes.title: BAPTISTE IS COMING SOON TO KICKSTARTER!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share that there will be a Kickstarter campaign for Baptiste very soon! After several months of working on the game and seeing the great reception it has had, we have made this decision because we wanted to [b]make the community a bigger part of the process and to deliver the best possible experience to you, players[/b]. 

The game is coming along well, and[b] it is going to get released[/b] no matter what happens with the crowdfunding campaign, but it will allow us to polish the end product so you will receive [b]an even better version[/b].

That’s why we will very soon launch this Kickstarter campaign for the game, where you will be able to learn more about the chilling tale of Sarah and Tom and support the project, and you will get some [b]amazing rewards[/b] along the way, including a Collector’s Physical Edition, your very own Baptiste, digital goodies and much more. 

The [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/firenut-games/baptiste-haunted-mansion-terror-with-a-cursed-doll-awaits]pre-campaign is now officially open[/url][/b], so make sure you click the [b]Notify Me On Launch[/b] button to be the first one to know when the campaign goes live and not to miss the early birds!

Are you ready to meet Baptiste in all his glory?

notes.title: Unveiling the Official Announcement Trailer for Baptiste!
notes.notes:
Hello, Baptiste community!

The moment we've all been waiting for is finally here — we are beyond excited to unveil the official Baptiste announcement trailer! This trailer offers a haunting glimpse into the dark and mysterious universe of Baptiste, where the sinister doll lurks in the shadows, and nightmares take form.

But this is just the beginning. Your support and feedback mean the world to us. As we continue to shape and refine Baptiste, we want to hear your thoughts on the trailer — what intrigued you the most? Which moments sent shivers down your spine? Are there any elements you’re eager to learn more about?

Let us know in the comments below or in the community discussions. Your voice helps us build the most terrifying and immersive experience possible.

Thank you for being a part of this journey. Stay tuned for more updates and surprises — the nightmare has only just begun.

Watch the trailer now and step into the world of Baptiste... if you dare.

notes.title: Baptiste: Redefining Horror, Joins Steam Next Fest Today
notes.notes:
Baptiste, the video game that's redefining the horror genre, launches today at 19:00 (GMT+2) at the Steam Next Fest. This event, known for showcasing the most innovative titles, will feature Baptiste, a game that delves into the dark abyss of human fear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329583/f1b800f7553e6e5bf2421a5d34f23ddc59f08142.png[/img]

[b]Main Features:[/b]

[b]Total Immersion:[/b] Submerge yourself in a first-person experience so real you'll feel each chill on your skin. With every step you take, the line between game and reality blurs.

[b]Suffocating Atmosphere: [/b]Explore a mansion where horror lurks in every shadow. With masterful voice acting and a soundtrack that will drag you into a nightmare, darkness becomes your worst enemy, testing your bravery at every corner.

[b]Tormented Protagonist: [/b]Play as Tom, a young man scarred by tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what should be a fresh start. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you maintain control against the onslaught of his inner demons?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329583/a25acb501423683c770804bd6fc9d2bc218cfe33.png[/img]

[b]Bloodthirsty Mysteries:[/b] Uncover the gruesome secrets that permeate every floorboard and every crack in the walls. Each revelation will unravel a story of pain and horror beyond belief.

[b]Disturbing Aesthetic:[/b] Immerse yourself in a world where beauty and terror intertwine in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a realm where the grotesque becomes fascinating.
[b]
Engrossing Narrative:[/b] Every objective, note, and whisper weaves the plot further. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that keep you on edge until the very end.

Prepare to experience unparalleled horror with Baptiste at the Steam Next Fest. Are you ready to confront your worst nightmares? Join us today at 19:00 (GMT+2) and discover what awaits you in the darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329583/bd65af9e73543cfcf822c838fff2f1212a24e430.png[/img]

notes.title: Baptiste: Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Discover the new and exclusive Demo of Baptiste.[/b]

Baptiste is a chilling psychological horror experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Set in a dark and mysterious world, you step into the shoes of Baptiste, a man tormented by his past and the horrors that haunt him. The game combines immersive storytelling with tense, atmospheric gameplay, making every corner feel like a threat. Solve eerie puzzles, face terrifying entities, and uncover the secrets hidden within the shadows. 

As you navigate through haunting environments, your decisions and actions will influence the outcome of your story. Prepare for a nerve-wracking journey where nothing is as it seems, and danger lurks around every corner.
